frontend/src/store/bookContinuousPlaybac.purpose: Chapter-by-chapter auto-advancing whole-book playback engine with auto-saved resume position -- replaces loading the assembled audiobook file as one clip

exports.name: buildChapterQueue
exports.contract: (chapters) -> BookChapterQueueEntry[]{chapterId,title,audioUrl}. Pure filter to only rendered chapters (audio_file_path set), book order preserved. URL built identically to ChapterTable.tsx's per-chapter play button.

exports.name: playBookContinuous
exports.contract: (bookId, bookTitle, queue) -> void. Resumes from getAutoResumeBookmark if its chapter is still in queue (seeks after loadAndPlay), else starts at index 0. Wires onPrev/onNext/onEnded to a CLOSURE-scoped (not module-global) index. Last chapter's onEnded calls clearAutoResumeBookmark + stop() instead of looping to chapter 1.

exports.name: useAutoSaveResumePosition
exports.contract: (bookId, queue) -> void. Subscribes to playerBus; persists via upsertAutoResumeBookmark only when playerBus.bookId===bookId && playing, throttled to ~once/5s via a useRef timestamp (not setInterval/setTimeout).

notes: 2026-07-12: added per owner design call (auto-save continuously, skip unrendered chapters silently) as a follow-up to a confirmed crash (multi-hour assembled audiobook file could hang/crash the tab via PlayerBar's unknown-duration bootstrap). Matches audio-player.md's own long-standing 'book playback, chapters sequenced via onEnded' line (§4.1), which had never actually been implemented until this change. Spec bumped to 1.6.9 (§4.2).
